title: Keep every visible jump time and adaptive stopping in the lower bound
statement: For the specified source, every-history filter |E[b|visible past]|<=2epsilon makes the visible intensity differ from 1/2 by at most epsilon^2 during active calls. Complete-record relative entropy is bounded by 2epsilon^4 E T_active, including adaptive switching, stopping and all failed attempts. Binary-test data processing yields the displayed lower bound. Equal returned state marginals alone fail: a hypothesis-bearing completion clock or exposed old hidden bit invalidates it.

requires: Specified four-state reversible generator theta in [0,1/4], visible a only and actual switching between theta=0 and unknown theta
Hypothesis-independent complete initializer; sequential specimen or actual independent copies
Well-defined useful certifier that accepts exact matches and rejects the separated alternative with stated errors

assumptions: The complete exposed initializer instrument, including timing, failed attempts and seeds, must be hypothesis independent and reveal neither old b nor the new hidden generation mark. Independent simultaneous specimens need joint conditional independent noise and fresh initializers; cost sums all active times rather than wall time against unlimited hardware. The exact known parametric family/filter and arbitrary computation are allowed to the ordinary estimator. An actual hidden swap/read port changes the experiment and permits O(epsilon^-2) cost.
costs: Sum active physical source time over every attempt/specimen; full preparation, readout and apparatus work are extra
No universal thermodynamic law, generic statistical-rate novelty or matched all-apparatus constants
